description: Implementation of TestMojoMediaClient class for media testing, including media renderer creation, media library initialization, and CDM factory creation.

classes.name: TestMojoMediaClient
classes.description: A test media client class for creating media renderers and CDM factories, managing media initialization, and handling audio/video sinks.

methods.name: ~TestMojoMediaClient
methods.description: Destructor for TestMojoMediaClient, shuts down audio manager if initialized.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes media library and audio manager for testing.

methods.name: CreateRenderer
methods.description: Creates a media renderer with associated audio and video sinks for testing.

methods.name: CreateCastRenderer
methods.description: Creates a cast renderer, if cast renderer support is enabled.

methods.name: CreateCdmFactory
methods.description: Creates a default CDM factory for media decryption.
